recent_game.fact: Auburn defeated Vanderbilt 21-15 on Sept. 26 to improve to 3-1 overall and 1-1 in the SEC.
Against Vanderbilt, Auburn produced 279 total yards, including 139 rushing and 140 passing.
Auburn allowed Vanderbilt 311 total yards, recorded eight tackles for loss and four sacks, and intercepted one pass.
Auburn ran the final 6:26 off the clock against Vanderbilt with an 11-play, 46-yard drive.
Jeremiah Cobb rushed for four yards on three first-half carries against Vanderbilt but finished with a game-high 58 yards on eight carries after gaining 54 yards on five second-half attempts.

opponent_notes.fact: Auburn is scheduled to play at Ole Miss on Oct. 31, 2026; Ole Miss was ranked No. 9 in the AP poll and No. 12 in the coaches poll when this guide was issued.
Pete Golding is listed as Ole Miss' first-year head coach for the 2026 season.

quarterback.fact: Through four games, quarterback Byrum Brown had completed 82 of 126 passes for 896 yards, six touchdowns and five interceptions while rushing 62 times for 237 yards and three touchdowns.
Brown accounted for one passing touchdown and one rushing touchdown in the win over Vanderbilt.
Brown had 103 career touchdowns responsible for: 67 passing, 34 rushing and two receiving.
Brown had 36 career starts, the most among SEC quarterbacks and fourth most among active FBS quarterbacks at the time of publication.
Brown and center Cole Best had started 18 games together from 2024 through 2026.

offensive_personnel.fact: Auburn's starting offensive line against Vanderbilt was Jacob Strand at left tackle, Wilson Zierer at left guard, Cole Best at center, Kenneth McManus IV at right guard and Stanton Ramil at right tackle.

The listed offensive-line depth chart had Jo Simmons or Jacob Strand at left tackle, Strand or Wilson Zierer at left guard, Cole Best at center, Cole Skinner or Kenneth McManus IV at right guard, and Stanton Ramil at right tackle.
Auburn's top three receivers—Chas Nimrod, Keshaun Singleton and Jeremiah Koger—transferred from USF.
Through four games, Singleton had 22 receptions for 268 yards and one touchdown, Nimrod had 22 receptions for 240 yards and two touchdowns, and Koger had 10 receptions for 177 yards.
Auburn's running back depth chart listed Jeremiah Cobb first, followed by Omar Mabson II, Bryson Washington or Nykhai Davenport.

defensive_personnel.fact: Linebacker Xavier Atkins had 26 tackles, seven tackles for loss and three sacks through four games.
Atkins recorded a season-high three tackles for loss against Vanderbilt and had multiple tackles for loss in three of Auburn's first four games.
Linebacker Elijah Melendez led Auburn with 34 tackles through four games and also had six tackles for loss and two sacks.
Cornerback Andre Jordan Jr. had two interceptions through four games, including one returned 29 yards for a touchdown.
Auburn's sophomore defenders accounted for 118 tackles, 17 tackles for loss, seven sacks, one forced fumble and one interception over the first four games.

coaching_changes.fact: Alex Golesh is in his first season as Auburn's head coach and had a 3-1 record through four games.
Joel Gordon serves as Auburn's offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach and calls from the booth, while DJ Durkin is defensive coordinator and linebackers coach.
Golesh, Gordon and Brown were together for a fourth consecutive season in 2026 after working together at USF.
Tyler Hudanick serves as run game coordinator and offensive-line coach, and Tim Banks serves as co-defensive coordinator and safeties coach.

offensive_context.fact: Through four games, Auburn averaged 413.5 total yards, 235.0 passing yards, 178.5 rushing yards and 30.0 points per game.
Auburn converted 30 of 60 third downs through four games, a 50 percent rate.
Auburn rushed for 223 yards at 3.72 yards per carry in first halves and 491 yards at 5.22 yards per carry in second halves through four games.
Auburn recorded 44 explosive plays through four games using the guide's definition of passes of at least 15 yards and runs of at least 12 yards, split evenly between 22 passes and 22 runs.
Through four games, Auburn opponents had recorded 14 sacks and 25 tackles for loss against the Tigers.

defensive_context.fact: Through four games, Auburn allowed 365.8 total yards, 238.8 passing yards, 127.0 rushing yards and 20.8 points per game.
Auburn had 29 tackles for loss, 11 sacks and five interceptions through four games.
Auburn intercepted a pass in each of its first four games of 2026.
In 28 games under defensive coordinator DJ Durkin, Auburn allowed 21.0 points and 111.2 rushing yards per game.
Auburn's defense held opponents to a 34.3 percent third-down conversion rate through four games.

special_teams.fact: Against Vanderbilt, Auburn stopped a fake punt, blocked a punt that Cade Carlson returned 10 yards for a touchdown, and blocked a field-goal attempt.
Kicker Alex McPherson was 4-for-6 on field goals and 14-for-14 on extra points through four games, with a long field goal of 55 yards.
McPherson had made all 101 career extra-point attempts and 44 of 51 career field goals.
Punter Hudson Kaak averaged 39.9 yards on 13 punts through four games, placing five inside the 20-yard line.
Rayshawn Pleasant had five career non-offensive touchdowns, including three kickoff-return touchdowns and two interception-return touchdowns.
